rules.text: Ability: dexterity. Utilize: Modify footwear to give Advantage on wearer’s next Dexterity (Acrobatics) check (DC 10). Craft: Climber's Kit. Tool proficiency adds PB to ability checks using the tool; if also proficient in a skill used with the check, gain Advantage. Each Artisan tool needs its own proficiency.
